source_question: Which governed output was produced by this Agent Action?
source_effect: Records only the named semantic connection with exact endpoints, qualifiers, evidence, owner, lifecycle, and claim ceiling.

independent_meaning.state_parameter: W: independently defined typed semantic world and owned catalogs
common_constraints: Exact kind/source definition and approved meaning revision.
Exact source/target node kinds and revisions match one declared ordered pair.
Every required qualifier has its independently defined typed interpretation; closed qualifier object has no extra field.
Primary witness, subject, target, context, scope, source snapshot, epoch and time domain agree with the complete frame.
The selected evidence and provenance policy establishes the claimed recorded/as-of/executed/observed posture; missing authenticity is not manufactured.
kind_specific_constraints: action = s; output = t appears in its exact output set and action_receipt_ref binds this action/output/frame.
production_role and output_posture agree with the actual recorded output; mere planned outputs lack production evidence.

qualifiers.exact_role: record.receipt: source action, target output and exact provenance frame
qualifiers.interpretation: Resolve an exact action/output receipt with owner and provenance; distinguish local execution evidence from external-world authenticity.
qualifiers.success_condition: The exact raw token maps through the owner-selected revisioned catalog to this typed role; all record, endpoint and frame constraints in Meaning hold.

qualifiers.exact_role: record.production_role: exact relation-specific owned role/posture/purpose code, interpreted for this ordered endpoint pair
qualifiers.interpretation: Define the relation-specific role/code domain and its effect on meaning; membership in a code catalog is not authority, execution or success.
qualifiers.success_condition: The exact raw token maps through the owner-selected revisioned catalog to this typed role; all record, endpoint and frame constraints in Meaning hold.

qualifiers.exact_role: record.output_posture: exact relation-specific owned role/posture/purpose code, interpreted for this ordered endpoint pair
qualifiers.interpretation: Define the exact posture/mode/purpose domain and distinguish declaration, attempted action, observation and accepted evidence; do not equate a label with successful execution.
qualifiers.success_condition: The exact raw token maps through the owner-selected revisioned catalog to this typed role; all record, endpoint and frame constraints in Meaning hold.

operational_effect.meaning: Record exact produced output and posture; preserve acceptance, correctness, admission and authority effect as separate facts.
operational_effect.record_delta: Append one exact immutable witnessed relation record, or idempotently retain an identical existing revision; same revision with different content is refused.
operational_effect.recording_preservation: Recording a relation preserves authority roots, ownership, identity classes, admissions and runtime/external state. A separately authorized execution can change only its approved domain envelope.
operational_effect.execution_boundary: A record append does not implement its source witness's execution. Materialization requires evidence of a completed authorized atomic application; no standalone relation row proves it.

forbidden_conclusions.label: acceptance
forbidden_conclusions.definition: An actual exact owner acceptance event exists for the governed output under the selected policy.
forbidden_conclusions.anchor: the exact endpoint or output/action explicitly joined by this relation's primary witness; specification, decision, environment and execution are separate exact owned references
forbidden_conclusions.context_rule: Endpoint anchors come from this exact primary witness. Any extra variables are existential typed references in the independently owned catalog and exact frame; none is supplied as an asserted conclusion flag.
forbidden_conclusions.scope: Non-entailment in the exact pinned relation/source theory; no universal falsity claim.

countermodel_blueprint.antecedent: Action A produces candidate Output O, which is later rejected by its owner.
countermodel_blueprint.conclusion: Absent/false AcceptedArtifact for the exact anchored participants under its independent definition.
countermodel_blueprint.validity_requirement: Construct and check every primary-witness constraint and complete source theory; this prose blueprint is not a checked countermodel.

forbidden_conclusions.additional_global_obligation: Prove full-rule closure/state preservation for protected authority, identity and ownership when applicable; a local blueprint alone does not establish it.

worked_failure: A receipt for a planned or different output cannot justify this production claim.
source_refinement_contract: Under exact owned catalog/frame well-formedness, decoding and resolution of raw source fields yields a iff the independently specified source constraints denote Meaning_K30(W,a). The decoder/checker must not define that source predicate.
proof_contract: Prove the independent meaning has a valid positive model.
Prove each exact qualifier mapping and checker/meaning equivalence.
Prove declared record effect and any required execution/closure preservation.
Check each kind-scoped non-entailment countermodel under the complete pinned theory.
Account for all declared ordered pairs and prove role-sensitive branches; one positive example per kind is insufficient.
